Requirements: R-17, R-4
Plan row: TS-3

Obligations: OB-3-1

## Given
- A run-unique code datasource (`tc003-<random>`), COMPLETED, created and deleted by the case (P-double). Baseline stamp B0 by raw GET.

## When
1. Trigger a manual full reindex (call 1); record client clock C1; read the stamp S1 by an independent GET after the call returns.
2. Wait a few hundred milliseconds and trigger a second full reindex (call 2); record C2. If the product rejects call 2 (4xx/409), record that and continue with the negative branch.
3. Poll until the datasource is COMPLETED and no longer in-progress (bounded timeout), then read the final stamp SF twice.

## Then
1. SF is later than or equal to S1 and, when call 2 was accepted, not earlier than C2 minus the clock tolerance. If call 2 was rejected, SF equals S1 (first stamp intact) and the order claim is inconclusive.
2. Both SF reads are equal and neither equals B0 or reverts to an earlier value than S1 (an outdated timestamp is not restored).

## Self-probe notes
- Discrimination: a stale in-memory IndexInfo written back by a full update after the second run would give SF earlier than S1/C2, failing Then 1/2; the unfixed code leaves B0 and fails Then 2.
- Oracle strength: later-trigger-wins is only implied by AC-3 (confidence low); it is a design assumption, a mismatch is a question not a verdict.
- Reads are independent GETs after polling to completion of both runs.

## Obligation coverage
| obligation/part | oracle | boundary | Then/evidence | residual gap |

| OB-3-1 final stamp not earlier than second trigger | R-4 | details API | Then 1 | rejection of call 2 is inconclusive |
